elements.name: Life
elements.world: Plants grow and spread where there's soil, water and light; everything alive carries it; rare Life springs glow in hidden places.
elements.cast: Heals anything living it touches and mends their marks; grows plants on wet ground, sand, stone and wood; summons plants, little creatures, elemental creatures (Life mixed with another element) or wakes up material that's there.
elements.draw: Plants, creatures (drains them a little), Life springs.

elements.name: Heat
elements.world: Fire, embers and lava give it off; it spreads to anything flammable.
elements.cast: Ignites wood, plants, oil and gunpowder; boils water to steam; melts ice; with sustained heat turns sand to glass, metal to molten metal and stone to lava. Burns creatures, eating their cells.
elements.draw: Fire, lava (drawing heat cools lava to stone).

elements.name: Cold
elements.world: Ice, and cold caverns where water freezes on its own.
elements.cast: Freezes water into ice (bridges, platforms, plugs); turns lava to obsidian and molten metal back to metal; condenses steam into rain; puts fire out. Slows creatures, then freezes them solid.

elements.name: Lightning
elements.world: Storm crystals that crackle, and charged ore.
elements.cast: Arcs along water, acid and metal to everything they touch; ignites flammables and sets off gunpowder; fuses sand to glass where it strikes. Stuns creatures, wet ones for longer.

elements.name: Force
elements.world: Gusts from vents and cracks that push loose stuff about.
elements.cast: Shoves loose cells (liquids, powders, gases) and creatures away; strong enough, breaks stone to rubble and shatters glass and ice. Cast on yourself it's movement: a launch, a levitation, a dash.

elements.name: Decay
elements.world: Rot and fungus that creep across wood and plants, giving off miasma.
elements.cast: Withers plants and rots wood to rot (then dust); corrodes metal to rubble, slowly; poisons creatures, rotting their cells away over time. Life and Decay cancel where they meet.

elements.name: Light
elements.world: Glowing crystals, and glow-moss (where Life and Light meet). The world is dark; light is precious.
elements.cast: Lights up the dark around where it lands, for a while; plants grow faster in it; makes glass and ice glow; blinds creatures and scorches dark ones. A sustained beam warms what it hits.

elements.name: Gravity
elements.world: Odd lodestones that tug at loose things around them.
elements.cast: Pulls loose cells and creatures towards a point, or lifts them: draw a pool of water up into a floating ball, haul sand into a heap, compact sand into stone with enough of it.

elements.name: Void
elements.world: Rifts: rare, dangerous tears that eat what drifts into them.
elements.cast: Unmakes the cells it touches, digging clean holes through anything but obsidian; cast on yourself, it moves you (a blink). Eats creatures' cells, yours included if you're careless.

elements.name: Water
elements.world: Pools, streams, drips from wet ceilings.
elements.cast: Makes water: floods, fills, washes things away. Puts out fire, conducts lightning, freezes to ice, boils to steam, feeds plants, breaks falls, dilutes acid.

elements.name: Oil
elements.world: Dark seeps and pools; floats on water.
elements.cast: Makes oil: a slick that floats on water and burns long, spreading fire across a pool.

elements.name: Lava
elements.world: Slow pools and flows deep down; lights its surroundings.
elements.cast: Makes lava: slow, burning, sets anything flammable alight. Water turns it to obsidian (with steam), cold to obsidian, time and drawing its heat to stone.
elements.draw: Lava (as a substance; its heat is Heat).

elements.name: Acid
elements.world: Bubbling pools in old places, eating slowly at their banks.
elements.cast: Makes acid: eats stone, metal, sand, wood, plants and bodies cell by cell, used up as it goes, giving off smoke. Obsidian and glass resist it; water dilutes it.

elements.name: Sand
elements.world: Dunes, drifts and loose ceilings that pour when disturbed.
elements.cast: Makes sand: falls, piles, buries, plugs gaps, cushions falls. Heat turns it to glass; lightning fuses it where it strikes; enough gravity packs it into stone.

elements.name: Stone
elements.world: Most of the world.
elements.cast: Makes stone: walls, bridges, stairs, plugs. Force breaks it to rubble; acid eats it; enough heat melts it to lava.

elements.name: Gunpowder
elements.world: Seams in the rock and old caches.
elements.cast: Makes gunpowder: a trail or a heap that explodes with heat, fire, lava or lightning, blasting terrain and anything nearby.

elements.name: Metal
elements.world: Ore veins and old structures.
elements.cast: Makes metal: heavy and tough (force won't break it); conducts lightning; sustained heat melts it to molten metal, which sets again; decay and acid wear it down slowly.

elements.name: Steam
elements.world: Water plus heat. Rises, scalds creatures, condenses back to water on cold or after a while (rain from the ceiling).
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: a scalding cloud that rises.

elements.name: Smoke
elements.world: Anything burning, and acid eating. Rises, hides what's behind it, fades.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: a cloud to hide in or behind.

elements.name: Fire
elements.world: Burning cells. Spreads along wood, plants and oil; rises; dies to smoke; water puts it out.
elements.cast: Makes fire: loose flames that lick upwards, burn out fast and set alight anything flammable they touch. (Heat on anything flammable makes it too.)

elements.name: Ice
elements.world: Water plus cold. Solid and slippery; melts with heat; force shatters it.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: instant platforms and walls.

elements.name: Obsidian
elements.world: Lava plus water or cold. The toughest thing: resists acid, void and almost all force.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: an expensive, near-unbreakable wall.

elements.name: Glass
elements.world: Sand plus heat or lightning. Clear, brittle (force shatters it back to sand), resists acid, lets light through and glows with it.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: see-through walls and windows.

elements.name: Rubble
elements.world: Stone broken by force; corroded metal. A coarse powder that falls and piles like sand.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: like sand, but it won't melt to glass.

elements.name: Molten metal
elements.world: Metal plus sustained heat. A heavy, burning liquid that sets back into metal (fast with water or cold).
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: pour it into a gap and let it set.

elements.name: Plants and wood
elements.world: Life's doing: grass, moss, vines, roots and trees. Grow with water and light; burn; rot with decay. Moss softens falls.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in, or grown with Life.

elements.name: Rot and miasma
elements.world: Decay's leftovers: rot creeps across wood and plants; miasma is a low poison gas that hurts the living. Life clears both; fire burns miasma off.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: a lingering poison cloud.

elements.name: Shadow
elements.world: Shadow pools in the deepest places: patches of dark that swallow light.
elements.cast: Light's opposite, as Decay is Life's: snuffs light (glowing crystals and moss dim, fire still burns but stops lighting things), pools darkness you can hide in, makes plants wilt, and feeds dark things. Light and Shadow cancel where they meet.

elements.name: Magnetism
elements.world: Magnetite: dark ore that drags loose metal towards it.
elements.cast: Gravity for metal only: pulls metal in or flings it away, drags creatures that carry or are made of metal, and lines metal filings up into bridges.

elements.name: Sound
elements.world: Echoing caves and singing crystals that hum when touched.
elements.cast: A shockwave: shatters glass, ice, crystal and bone; shakes loose ceilings and sand down; stuns creatures, and wakes, lures or scares them.

elements.name: Time
elements.world: Still pockets where nothing moves: a waterfall frozen mid-pour, dust hanging in the air.
elements.cast: Slows or speeds the world where it lands: slowed, liquids stop, fire hangs, creatures crawl; sped up, plants grow, bloom and rot, wood ages, lava cools, honey turns to amber. Rare and powerful.

elements.name: Mud
elements.world: Made by water and dirt. Thick and slow, slows whatever wades in, cushions falls, dries back to dirt with heat or time.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: a slow, clinging flood.

elements.name: Slime
elements.world: Slime pools, and the trails slimes leave.
elements.cast: Makes slime: sticks to walls and ceilings, slows creatures caught in it, and bounces you higher off it. Salt shrivels it; fire dries it out.

elements.name: Mercury
elements.world: Heavy silver pools at the bottom of everything.
elements.cast: Makes mercury: a liquid metal that sinks below every other liquid, conducts lightning, and poisons the living.

elements.name: Blood
elements.world: Comes from hurt creatures (theirs, not yours: the player is cells and ink).
elements.cast: Makes blood: slippery underfoot. Life grows things lush in it; Decay feeds on it.

elements.name: Honey (sap)
elements.world: Oozes from plants and old trees.
elements.cast: Makes honey: sticky and slow, traps small creatures, heals a little; burns, then hardens; Time turns it to amber.
elements.draw: Plants and trees that weep it.

elements.name: Tar
elements.world: Black pits and seeps.
elements.cast: Makes tar: black, sticky and slow; burns long and smoky; sets hard with cold.

elements.name: Spirits
elements.world: Strange stills and forgotten casks.
elements.cast: Makes spirits: thin, evaporates, burns fast with a pale blue flame, and washes rot and slime away.

elements.name: Liquid mana
elements.world: Glowing pools of raw magic, rare and precious.
elements.cast: Makes liquid mana: standing in it refills your mana; it lights its surroundings; Void meeting it unmakes everything nearby in a violent burst.

elements.name: Swamp gas
elements.world: Rises from rot and mud, faint and hard to see.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: a cloud that explodes with any spark or flame.

elements.name: Mist
elements.world: Hangs low in damp places; hides what's in it; rains out slowly into water; cold turns it to snow.
elements.cast: Makes mist: cover to hide in, and slow rain.

elements.name: Spores
elements.world: Made by fungus: drift on the air and grow fungus where they land. Life speeds them; fire burns them.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: sow fungus wherever they settle.

elements.name: Plasma
elements.world: Made by heat and lightning together: an extremely hot glowing gas that melts almost anything, briefly, then fades.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: a short burst that melts through nearly everything.

elements.name: Dirt
elements.world: Soil: the ground plants grow best in.
elements.cast: Makes dirt: piles like sand but holds a slope; water turns it to mud; Life's favourite ground.

elements.name: Clay
elements.world: Dense banks by water.
elements.cast: Makes clay: holds whatever shape it's given; water softens it to mud; heat fires it into brick.

elements.name: Salt
elements.world: Crusts and flats where water has dried.
elements.cast: Makes salt: melts ice and snow, dissolves into water (salty water won't freeze and plants won't grow in it), stops rot and decay where it's scattered, and shrivels slimes.

elements.name: Snow
elements.world: Drifts in cold places; cold makes it from mist and water in the air.
elements.cast: Makes snow: a light powder that cushions falls best of all, melts to water, and packs into ice.

elements.name: Coal
elements.world: Seams in the rock; made when wood burns without air (buried under sand or dirt).
elements.cast: Makes coal: the best fuel, burning long and hot.

elements.name: Crystal
elements.world: Grows slowly in caves (Time speeds it).
elements.cast: Makes crystal: rings when struck (and Sound shatters it), stores Light and glows with it, and splits lightning into several arcs.

elements.name: Brick
elements.world: Made by clay and heat: tough, doesn't burn; acid eats it slowly; only strong Force breaks it.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: a solid wall that won't catch fire.

elements.name: Gold
elements.world: Veins and nuggets, worth finding. In the guide's reward gold on purpose: it is treasure.
elements.cast: Makes gold: soft and heavy, never corrodes (acid and decay don't touch it), melts easily with heat and sets again.

elements.name: Bone
elements.world: What's left of creatures.
elements.cast: Makes bone: brittle to Force and Sound; Life can stand bones back up as skeletons (waking what's there).

elements.name: Fungus
elements.world: Grows in the dark on rot and wood, glows faintly, and puffs spores. Decay feeds it rather than killing it.
elements.cast: Makes fungus: a glowing growth that spreads over rot and wood.

elements.name: Seeds
elements.world: Scatter on the wind and from plants.
elements.cast: Makes seeds: they sprout into the plant they came from with water and dirt, faster with Life; fire burns them.

elements.name: Ash
elements.world: Made by burning: a light powder that drifts, smothers small fires, and makes soil richer for plants.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: smother a fire, or feed a garden.

elements.name: Thermite
elements.world: Rare deposits of rusty powder.
elements.cast: Makes thermite: once lit by lightning or intense heat it burns hotter than anything, straight through metal and stone.

elements.name: Ectoplasm
elements.world: Made where Shadow and Life meet: a ghostly goo that glows, drifts upward, lets things pass through it, and haunts. Light dispels it.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: a glowing haze things pass through.

elements.name: Quicksand
elements.world: Wet sand in deserts and swamps that swallows what stands still in it; moving (struggling) gets you out slowly. Cold freezes it solid.
elements.cast: Makes quicksand: a trap that drags creatures down.

elements.name: Amber
elements.world: Made by honey or sap hardening over Time: clear and golden, preserving whatever is caught inside. Heat melts it back.
elements.cast: Castable once drawn in: trap something in amber.

decay: Rots, then dust; gives off miasma
